routes.title: Routes
routes.description: One route per line as ORIGIN-DESTINATION. IATA codes are fastest (CGK-DPS), but city names work too (Jakarta-Denpasar). Accepted separators: -, ->, >, or the word 'to'.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Single-route alternative to the Routes list: origin IATA code or city name.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Single-route alternative to the Routes list: destination IATA code or city name.

roundTrip.title: Round trip
roundTrip.description: Price a return journey. Turn off to price one way; note that the date grid is inherently a depart-by-return matrix and is most useful for round trips.

departDate.title: First departure date
departDate.description: Start of the departure window in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days from today.

departWindowDays.title: Departure window (days)
departWindowDays.description: How many consecutive departure dates to price from the first departure date.

returnDate.title: First return date
returnDate.description: Start of the return window in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 37 days from today.

returnWindowDays.title: Return window (days)
returnWindowDays.description: How many consecutive return dates to price. Departure days multiplied by return days is capped at 100 per request; larger windows are split automatically.

includeMonthlyCurve.title: Include 12-month cheapest curve
includeMonthlyCurve.description: Pull the cheapest fare for each of the next 12 months on this route. One request per route, and the best signal for seasonality.
includeMonthlyCurve.groupDescription: Both surfaces are cheap; the monthly curve is one request per route.

includeDateGrid.title: Include departure-by-return date grid
includeDateGrid.description: Pull the cheapest fare for each departure and return date pair in the chosen windows.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Adult passengers. Fares are per booking, so this changes the quoted totals.

priceThreshold.title: Price alert threshold
priceThreshold.description: Optional fare threshold in the selected currency. Any route whose lowest fare falls to or below this value is flagged with summary.belowThreshold, which is what you hook a Slack or Telegram webhook to.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Traveloka locale, which affects labels in the response.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency for all fares in the output.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
requestDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to pause between API calls. Raise it if you see repeated 429 or 5xx responses.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Residential is the default: Traveloka's AWS WAF answers a captcha to the session bootstrap on most Apify datacenter IPs. If you pick a datacenter group, the actor tries it first and falls back to residential sessions when it is challenged.
